SELECT u.id AS userId, u.username AS username, u.real_name AS realName, u.phone AS phone, COUNT(DISTINCT c.activity_id) AS activityCount, COALESCE(SUM(c.duration), 0) AS totalMinutes, MAX(c.check_out_time) AS lastServiceTime FROM sys_user u LEFT JOIN check_in_record c ON c.user_id = u.id AND c.duration IS NOT NULL WHERE u.role = 1
AND (u.real_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR u.username LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
GROUP BY u.id, u.username, u.real_name, u.phone ORDER BY totalMinutes DESC, u.id ASC
